title: [Lee Kum Kee] Chicken Bouillon Powder – Savory Cooking Seasoning | 273g | Soup, Stir-fry, Marinade
description:
[Lee Kum Kee] Chicken Bouillon Powder – Savory Cooking Seasoning | 273g | Soup, Stir-fry, Marinade

[Lee Kum Kee] Chicken Bouillon Powder – 273g
Rich Chicken Flavor | Versatile Cooking Base

✅ Information
Lee Kum Kee Chicken Bouillon Powder delivers deep and savory chicken taste, perfect for enhancing everyday dishes.
Use it as a seasoning for soups, stir-fried dishes, rice, noodles, or marinades.

Highlights
✔️ Authentic chicken flavor for Asian cooking
✔️ Easy-to-use powder type – dissolves quickly
✔️ Versatile: soups, fried rice, noodles, hot pot, and more
✔️ Trusted brand Lee Kum Kee – established quality

How to Enjoy
– Add 1 spoon to soup, broth, or stir-fry for extra umami
– Use as a marinade base for meat or vegetables
– Sprinkle into fried rice or noodles for instant flavor

⏲ Storage Instructions
Store in a cool, dry place. Reseal tightly after opening.

Packaging
All products are shipped without external boxes for eco-conscious and practical packaging.

Attentiveness – Every product is carefully selected and delivered with care.
Aspiration – Your satisfaction is our greatest motivation.

Delivery Information
Reliable Shipping: Arrives within 5 days!
